name: Batched matmul
description: Batched matrix multiply out[i] = a[i] @ b[i]. float16 inputs/output, accumulate in float32.
signature: run(a: Tensor[B, M, K], b: Tensor[B, K, N]) -> Tensor[B, M, N]
